title: 6301 Marble Falls Dr | Home for Sale in Killeen, TX | Elizabeth Thomas - Ace Real Estate Group
description:
Welcome to this stunning Carothers-built home! With 4 spacious bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, and 2 living areas, there’s room for everyone! One living room has a cozy wood-burning fireplace and the other has double tray ceilings. The kitchen has plenty of space—featuring an island, abundant counter space, and double ovens! You'll love the flexibility of both formal and breakfast dining areas! The secondary bedrooms are connected by a Jack and Jill bathroom, while the master suite is a true retreat with its own tray ceiling and large bathroom. But the real showstopper? The backyard! Imagine relaxing under the huge covered patio, surrounded by mature shade trees, a garden, and plenty of space to unwind or entertain.
